Ickenham&

Raised black slate patio, slatted hardwood fence

The garden had heavy clay soil, a low spot in the middle and years of flooding, after building work left broken concrete and rubble. We put in a full drainage system, re-levelled it and built the slate patio.

Eastcote&

Indian sandstone patio with raised sleeper beds

A contemporary take on sandstone: clean lines, raised sleeper beds and a Balau hardwood deck alongside.

Stanmore&

Porcelain patio, new lawn, stepping stones

Low maintenance by design: 900x450 Italian porcelain paving with cream jointing, turf and a line of stepping stones to the back.

Hyde Heath&

Porcelain patio and new lawn

Pale porcelain paving with stepping stones across fresh turf, under an existing apple tree.

Northwood&

Block paving driveway with a turf circle

A block paved driveway wrapped round a round lawn, with a new brick wall and hedging along the front.

Sleepers and hardwood&

Deck, steps and an oval lawn

Hardwood deck and steps held by sleepers, stepping stones across the lawn, a fence along the back.

Rickmansworth&

Sandstone patio with raised beds

Indian sandstone laid round raised sleeper beds, with trellis fencing along the boundary.

Wealdstone&

New level lawn under a pergola

Turfed on a levelled garden, with a hardwood pergola and slatted screen along the house.

Harrow&

Garden building, new lawn and paving

A timber-clad garden building with a paved path through two freshly laid lawns.

Harrow&

Concrete retaining wall and black slate

A curved concrete retaining wall rendered white, black slate paving and a lawn edge beside it.

A painted cream fence all round, porcelain paving and a lawn with stepping stones leading to a second terrace.

What we build.

Hard landscaping and planting from one team, in Harrow, Hillingdon, Ealing, Brent and Barnet.

  • Garden design

    Paul is a qualified landscape architect (BA Hons, Dip). We build to detailed drawings, or work more loosely and suggest as we build.

  • Paving and patios

    Natural stone, porcelain, slate, brick and concrete pavers. Patios, paths, steps, driveways and block paving.

  • Fencing

    Slatted hardwood, close board, picket, composite and metal. New, replacement or repair, and trellis.

  • Lawns and turfing

    Soil preparation, levelling, then roll-out turf or seed. New lawns for small and large gardens.

  • Garden drainage

    For waterlogged lawns and patios: French drains, soakaways and channel drains.

  • Concreting and walls

    Concrete paths and edging, retaining walls and brickwork.

  • Also raised beds, decking, garden clearances, ponds and water features, sheds and pagodas, green roofs, vegetable and wildlife gardens.

Design and the building, under one roof.

Paul is a fully qualified Landscape Architect (BA Hons, Dip) as well as a bricklayer and woodworker, so we can work from detailed drawings or loosely with you, making suggestions as we build.

Harrow & Hillingdon Landscape Gardeners is the domestic part of Ecospaces Ltd. Every garden transformation is filmed, so you can share the finished garden with friends and family.

Around three months to start.

We always have a waiting list of about three months for new gardens, so get in early if you want one ready for next summer.
